title: Repositories
hint: References for this assistant only. A binding is not permission to access a repository and does not identify a computer or checkout.
scope: Saved identity and purpose, without credentials
name: Name (optional)
unchecked: Parsed locally; existence not yet checked
edit_check: Only a changed repository identity is checked again.
check_hint: Checks repository existence only, anonymously. Empty repositories are valid. Private, hidden or unavailable repositories may be impossible to confirm; an inconclusive check cannot be saved. Self-hosted private networks require administrator-configured trusted targets.
verified: Existence confirmed at {time}; not checked again on reads
unbind_hint: This removes the saved reference only. It does not delete or change the remote repository. You can undo immediately after unbinding.
load_failed: Could not load repositories: the response is missing or belongs to another assistant.
save_unconfirmed: The change is unconfirmed. Refresh repositories before trying again.
invalid_url: Use a GitHub or GitLab HTTP(S) or git SSH link without credentials. Repository pages are accepted. Choose the provider for a self-hosted instance.
